cutoff.label: Through the Nīlakaṇṭha boundary
cutoff.note: Works securely dated before c. 1750 are counted. Śaiva Nīlakaṇṭha’s Tilaka is shown separately as the boundary item: Hazra places it no earlier than the mid-18th century. Works clearly later than this boundary are omitted. Manuscript-catalogued works with unresolved dates are shown separately and do not count as pre-boundary.
